name: LongHorn Steakhouse Receipt
description: This receipt is a LongHorn Steakhouse full-service restaurant POS transaction formatted in a structured thermal print layout. It includes the brand header, full store address, table number, check number, guest identifier, server name, and precise date/time stamp. The receipt features a guest-specific section followed by a promotional survey block with a unique ID number and detailed sweepstakes messaging. It includes a “Duplicate Receipt / Stored Order” designation and a financial summary section with subtotal, sales tax, and total due. The receipt also provides a gratuity guidance section with calculated tip suggestions and explanatory notes. The layout uses clear separators, boxed promotional messaging, and aligned totals consistent with U.S. casual dining receipt standards.
